title: Initiative Signal Tracking & Decision Reserve Runbook for Monthly Roadmap Cadence
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Purpose:
Create a concise, repeatable runbook that the Product team will use to:
1) surface Initiative Signals (quantitative and qualitative) ahead of the monthly roadmap cadence;
2) hold a Decision Reserve (pre-approved budget/time/rollout levers) to accelerate or pause initiatives during exec readouts;
3) produce a two-slide stakeholder summary (signal + recommended action) for each active initiative.

Background:
We currently prepare a lengthy packet for monthly roadmap syncs which often buries the delta signals execs care about. This ticket scopes a lighter-weight operational artefact that: collects signal definitions per initiative, standardizes thresholds for escalation, defines who can spend the Decision Reserve, and creates a lightweight attachment for exec readouts and QBRs.

Success criteria / acceptance criteria:
- A documented Runbook (single-page canonical doc + template) exists and is adopted by all PMs on the roadmap team.
- Signal taxonomy defined and mapped to metrics sources (console dashboards, usage events, customer health).
- Decision Reserve rules and guardrails documented (who approves, max spend, rollback triggers).
- Two-slide summary template produced and validated in a dry-run with Eng lead and Finance.
- At least one initiative used the Runbook during the next monthly cadence and the outcome recorded in post-mortem notes.

Scope (in):
- PM-owned initiatives across platform and hosting (hosted API, Dedicated, Private).
- Template for two-slide initiative summary + central signals index.
- Integration notes for Console dashboards and cost telemetry owners.

Out of scope (for this ticket):
- Full rework of roadmap governance; that will be separate.
- Changes to billing model or pricing.

Stakeholders:
- Product: Maya Thompson (creator), Rafael Ortega (assignee), Linh Vu (lead PM, Dedicated), Aaron Kim (owner, Console)
timeline: Mar 2026 - Pilot in Apr 2026 monthly cadence
metrics: Signals captured, Runbook adoption rate, avg time to decision in cadence, Decision Reserve spend vs approved cap
risks: Mis-aligned thresholds will cause churn; Decision Reserve abuse without clear rollback; insufficient telemetry coverage for low-signal initiatives
mitigation_plan: Start with conservative thresholds; require 2 approvers for any Decision Reserve allocation > $5k equivalent; staged rollout with pilot initiatives and telemetry gaps onboarding
deliverables: single-page runbook (doc link), two-slide template (pptx link), onboarding checklist for PMs, pilot summary note
comments: 2026-02-22 — Maya T: Draft signal taxonomy uploaded to Drive. Initial signals include: latency regressions > 15% at P95, cost per 1k tokens up >20%, feature usage drop >10% week-over-week, 2+ enterprise customers reporting blocker.
2026-02-25 — Rafael O: Reviewed taxonomy, added a short-form mapping to Console widgets. Flagged that some legacy models lack per-route token cost data (tracking ENG-3982).

2026-03-01 — Linh V: Proposed Decision Reserve cardinality: 3 buckets (tactical: $0-5k, operational: $5k-25k, strategic: >$25k requires Exec sponsor). Added requirement for EOU (estimated operational uplift) note with any spend request.
2026-03-03 — Aaron K: Confirmed Console can expose a 'signal snapshot' for each initiative via a pinned dashboard; engineering effort ~2 days. Added link to prototype dashboard in links section.
2026-03-05 — Rafael O: Prepared slide template and scheduled a 30-minute dry-run with Eng lead and Finance on 2026-03-10. Updated acceptance criteria to require dry-run validation.
postmortem_template: Was the Decision Reserve used? yes/no; Outcome summary; Lessons learned; Follow-ups (owners and due dates)
